🛒 How to use Groceries

  1. Find items — use the category tabs or the search box.
  2. Set the weight — type grams in the box, or tap 100g / 250g / 500g / 1kg. The price updates instantly.
  3. Add to cart — tap Add (or + for more of the same weight).
  4. Check out — open the cart bar at the bottom, review the total and place your order.
